b: Netflix has dropped the teaser for the sixth and final season of Emily in Paris, and it plays like the opening of a farewell tour: to Greece, where Emily (Lily Collins) and Mindy (Ashley Park) toast to “one last story” and Emily bumps into her old flame Gabriel (Lucas Bravo). Some sparks, apparently, survive any number of European detours.

Created by Darren Star, Emily in Paris premiered in 2020, at the height of the pandemic, and quickly became one of the streamer’s guiltiest of pleasures. Netflix confirmed in May that the sixth season would be its last, with production moving from Greece to Monaco before wrapping in Paris. Last season took place in Rome, where Emily’s romance with Eugenio Franceschini’s rising fashion mogul fizzled out.

Emily in Paris’s last sojourn sees Emily facing choices that test her loyalties, but (per usual) personal and professional conflicts force her to reevaluate the life she’s built in Paris. The final season premieres on December 24.
